## EMPYEMA/LUNG ABSCESS
Empyema is usually a complication of pneumonia. Diagnostic thoracentesis is
recommended in most cases. Pulmonary or Infectious Diseases consultation is
essential.
Inpatient ## Duration
The duration of antibiotic therapy for bacterial empyema is not well defined but
generally 4-6 weeks
## Empirical Treatment
[Ampicillin-Sulbactam 3 mg IV q6h [M]](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-q6h)
< OR >
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M]](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)
< OR >
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]](orz-set-abx-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h-metronidazole-500mg-po-q12h)
Suspected MRSA:
< ADD > vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h [R] to an antimicrobial regimen above
## Oral Step down
Preferred:
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h [R]](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)
<OR>
[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h [R]](psjzid-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-q12h)
<OR>
[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]](orz-set-abx-cefadroxil-100mg-po-q12h-metronidazole-500mgpo-q12h)
Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h [R,DI]](psjzid-levofloxacin-750mg-po-q24h)
< OR >
[Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]](orz-set-abx-levofloxacin-750mg-po-q24h-metronidzole500mgpoq12h)
